title: Nigerian Government and Politics
topics: The judiciary and the legal order

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Handover of 1999?
o: the office holder who deputises for the head of the federal executive and succeeds him if that office falls vacant
the conservative party of the region's traditional establishment, led by Ahmadu Bello
the informal rotation of party and public offices among the country's regions
the transfer of power to elected civilians after successive governments of soldiers
items.s: Handover of 1999: the transfer of power to elected civilians after successive governments of soldiers. The other options describe Vice president, Zoning, Northern People's Congress.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Judicial independence.
o: the lower federal chamber, whose members are apportioned by population across constituencies
the sacred ruler of the Edo kingdom whose court supported a guild of brass casters
the security of tenure and salary that lets judges decide without fear of the executive
a division of powers between a central government and constituent units each sovereign in its sphere
items.s: Judicial independence: the security of tenure and salary that lets judges decide without fear of the executive. The other options describe Oba of Benin, Federalism, House of Representatives.
items.t: The judiciary and the legal order

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Murtala Muhammed?
o: a political appointee who heads a federal department of state and answers for it
subjects not assigned to the centre, on which the constituent units legislate
the schedule of matters on which only the central legislature may make laws
the head of state who created additional states in 1976 and was assassinated the same year
items.s: Murtala Muhammed: the head of state who created additional states in 1976 and was assassinated the same year. The other options describe Exclusive legislative list, Residual matters, Minister.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Federal Executive Council?
o: the body charged with registering parties, keeping the voters register and conducting polls for the federation
the electoral district that a legislator represents
a traditional office holder recognised by a written instrument from the colonial governor
the body of ministers that the president chairs to direct national policy
items.s: Federal Executive Council: the body of ministers that the president chairs to direct national policy. The other options describe Constituency, Warrant chief, Independent National Electoral Commission.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Senate?
o: the head of state who moved the seat of government to Abuja and annulled the 1993 presidential election
the movement of a politician from one party to another while still holding office
the upper federal chamber, with three members from each state and one from the capital territory
the presiding officer elected by members of the lower federal chamber
items.s: Senate: the upper federal chamber, with three members from each state and one from the capital territory. The other options describe Speaker, Defection, Ibrahim Babangida.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Concurrent legislative list?
o: the elected head of a state executive, holding powers similar to the president within the state
the body that conducts polls into local government councils inside a constituent unit
the schedule of matters on which both central and state legislatures may legislate
the bench that reviews decisions in matters of Islamic personal law
items.s: Concurrent legislative list: the schedule of matters on which both central and state legislatures may legislate. The other options describe Governor, State Independent Electoral Commission, Sharia Court of Appeal.

items.q: State Executive Council may be defined as
o: the carving of new constituent units out of existing ones, done several times since 1967
the body of commissioners that a governor chairs to direct policy in his jurisdiction
the body that monitors and enforces balanced representation in national appointments
the trial bench of general jurisdiction, at federal or state level, for major civil and criminal cases
items.s: State Executive Council: the body of commissioners that a governor chairs to direct policy in his jurisdiction. The other options describe State creation, Federal Character Commission, High Court.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Supreme Court?
o: the 1963 instrument that replaced the monarch with an elected president as head of state
the apex bench in the land, from which no further appeal lies
the 1960 arrangement that left the queen as head of state represented by a governor-general
the gathering of adult males that settled disputes in a community without a king
items.s: Supreme Court: the apex bench in the land, from which no further appeal lies. The other options describe Igbo village assembly, Independence Constitution, Republican Constitution.
